criteria.rationale: The patient was 35 years old on the 2026-09-01 request date.
The request is for chronic weight management, and the prescribing note places Wegovy in the obesity treatment plan.
Within 180 days of the request, the patient reported cutting back on fast food and walking most evenings. The Wegovy plan says to continue the diet and walking.

The notes document diet and walking efforts, but do not establish a continuous six-month comprehensive program with continuing follow-up. “Past several months” is too vague to establish the required duration.
The latest structured BMI before the request was 35.7 kg/m², exceeding the primary threshold of 30.

missing_requirements: Documentation establishing at least six continuous months of participation in a comprehensive weight management program with diet, physical activity, and continuing follow-up.
parsed.summary: Age, indication, adjunct diet and activity, and BMI meet the modeled criteria. The available notes do not establish the required six months of continuous comprehensive-program participation, so the request is not ready.
